subcategory_text: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors, as these are opportunities for attackers to manipulate human behaviour through direct engagement.
implementation_examples: IG1: Install browser/email protections; DMARC for email
IG2: Use sandboxing; URL filtering; awareness training
IG3: Use browser isolation; advanced anti-phishing
assessment_objectives: Determine whether email and web are protected.
